cd /workspace/naive-hegel-study/05-json-unicode
# Native output stays in scratch. No target checkout edits.
timeout 120s cc -O3 -shared -fPIC -o libyyjson-jolt.so /workspace/pilot-targets/yyjson-jolt/native/shim.c /workspace/pilot-targets/yyjson-jolt/native/yyjson/yyjson.c -lm
timeout 120s sh run.sh witnesses
timeout 120s sh run.sh good
timeout 120s sh run.sh broken
timeout 120s sh run.sh replay
timeout 120s sh run.sh fixture

Each run.sh invocation starts a fresh Jolt process. broken writes replay.edn.
Full result files include printed exception objects; use replay.edn as the portable EDN replay artifact.
The control is an intentionally wrong encoder, not a discovered yyjson defect.
